issues.display_title: Issue #1622: Enhancement: GET /gstats/{session_id} to ADR pattern
issues.main_description_html:
Migrate gstatsDetails to Domain-Based ADR pattern (DTO + Repository + ExceptionMapper + standard response envelope).

Category B — already delegates to a legacy Action class (Gstats\Actions\GstatsDetails).

Affected API endpoint:

Method Path Current Controller@Action
GET /gstats/{session_id} Gstats\GstatsController@gstatsDetails

Note from Developer

Resolved by PR #1625 (enhance/issue-1622-gstats-details-adr, merged into main).

  • New GstatsDetailsController / GstatsDetailsAction / GstatsDetailsDto / GstatsRepository, replacing legacy GstatsController@gstatsDetails and Gstats\Actions\GstatsDetails. Legacy action class deleted.
  • Shared Gstats domain infrastructure introduced here (used by #1623, #1624): GstatsDomainException hierarchy + GstatsExceptionHttpMapper, GstatsSessionValidator, lang keys.
  • Response contract preserved: success body unchanged (legacy shape: data.message singular, accounts top-level); error bodies gain a machine-readable data.reason.
domainCode HTTP Condition
GSTATS.INVALID_INPUT 400 session_id missing or blank, when strictly validated
GSTATS.SESSION_NOT_FOUND 404 no google_plus row for that session_id

Affected API endpoint:

Method Path API Docs
GET /gstats/{session_id} gstats-details.md

issues.display_title: Issue #1623: Enhancement: GET /gstats/publish/count/{session_id} to ADR pattern
issues.main_description_html:
Migrate getTotalPublishByEmail to Domain-Based ADR pattern (DTO + Repository + ExceptionMapper + standard response envelope).

Category B — already delegates to a legacy Action class (Gstats\Actions\GetTotalPublishByEmail).

Affected API endpoint:

Method Path Current Controller@Action
GET /gstats/publish/count/{session_id} Gstats\GstatsController@getTotalPublishByEmail

Note from Developer

Resolved by PR #1626 (enhance/issue-1623-gstats-total-publish-adr, stacked on #1625, merged into main).

  • New GetTotalPublishController / GetTotalPublishAction / GetTotalPublishDto / GstatsStatsRepository, replacing legacy GstatsController@getTotalPublishByEmail and Gstats\Actions\GetTotalPublishByEmail. Legacy action class deleted.
  • Elasticsearch read isolated in GstatsStatsRepository::countPublishes(); GstatsClass::getTotalPublish() removed as dead code.

issues.display_title: Issue #1624: Enhancement: GET /gstats/portofolio/details/{session_id} to ADR pattern
issues.main_description_html:
Migrate getDetailStatsSession to Domain-Based ADR pattern (DTO + Repository + ExceptionMapper + standard response envelope).

Category B — already delegates to a legacy Action class (Gstats\Actions\GetDetailStatsSession).

Affected API endpoint:

Method Path Current Controller@Action
GET /gstats/portofolio/details/{session_id} Gstats\GstatsController@getDetailStatsSession

Note from Developer

Resolved by PR #1627 (enhance/issue-1624-gstats-detail-stats-adr, stacked on #1626, merged into main).

  • New GetDetailStatsController / GetDetailStatsAction / GetDetailStatsDto / GstatsGraphHelper, replacing legacy GstatsController@getDetailStatsSession and Gstats\Actions\GetDetailStatsSession. Both deleted. This is the last Gstats endpoint, so GstatsController and App\Class\GstatsClass are also deleted — the domain is fully ADR.
  • Graph pipeline (~150 lines) extracted from GstatsClass::detailStats() into GstatsGraphHelper::build(), a pure function with 13 unit tests.
  • SQL in GstatsRepository, Elasticsearch read in GstatsStatsRepository::findWeeklyStats(), Redis read-through translation cache in GstatsTranslationCache.
  • Bugs fixed: (1) an unknown session_id queried Elasticsearch with null user_id and returned an empty dashboard with HTTP 200 — now GSTATS.SESSION_NOT_FOUND (404); (2) corrupt panos payloads raised a PHP warning and counted as 0 panoramas — now skipped explicitly.
  • Dead code removed: detailStats() built an $aTranslate map that was never read; page_cache was always assigned the raw cached map. The substitution is not reimplemented.
  • Response contract preserved: success body unchanged (legacy shape: result at data level, data.messages, nested fields); error bodies gain a machine-readable data.reason.
domainCode HTTP Condition
GSTATS.INVALID_INPUT 400 session_id missing or blank, when strictly validated
GSTATS.SESSION_NOT_FOUND 404 no google_plus row for that session_id

issues.display_title: Issue #1633: Enhancement: GET /support/product to ADR pattern
issues.main_description_html:
Wrap this endpoint to the strict Domain-Based ADR pattern (DTO + Repository + ExceptionMapper + standard response envelope).

Reference: docs/ADR_MIGRATION_CANDIDATES.md

Note from Developer

Resolved by PR #1638 (enhance/issue-1633-support-product-list, merged into main).

  • New ListProductsController / ListProductsAction / ListProductsDto / shared ProductRepository, replacing legacy Support\Product\ProductController@listProducts and legacy Actions\ListProducts.
  • Shared Support Product domain infrastructure introduced here (used by #1634, #1635, #1636, #1637): SuperUserValidator, SupportDomainException hierarchy, SupportExceptionHttpMapper, and ProductRepository against ccdb.product.
  • Response contract preserved as an encrypted envelope. Legacy paging/search behavior is kept: blank or zero limit and page fall back to 10 / 1; unrecognized searchBy applies no filter. is_active remains rendered as Active / Not Active in list rows.
  • Behavior change: the super-user gate now maps to 403 instead of legacy 409.
